# Internal Wiki Application

## Context
Build a simple internal wiki for team knowledge sharing. Self-contained Python/Flask app with SQLite storage, Markdown content, full-text search, tags, and revision history.

## Project Structure
```
wiki/
  app.py              # Flask app (single file, ~8 routes)
  schema.sql          # SQLite DDL + seed data
  requirements.txt    # Flask, Markdown, bleach
  templates/
    base.html         # Bootstrap 5 layout + navbar
    index.html        # Page list with tag filter
    page.html         # View rendered page
    form.html         # Create/edit form (shared)
    history.html      # Revision list
    revision.html     # View old revision
    search.html       # Search results
  static/
    style.css         # Minimal CSS (~50 lines)
```

## Database Schema (4 tables + FTS5)
- **pages**: id, slug, title, content, created_at, updated_at
- **revisions**: id, page_id, title, content, created_at (full snapshots on each save)
- **tags**: id, name
- **page_tags**: page_id, tag_id (junction)
- **pages_fts**: FTS5 virtual table on title+content with sync triggers

## Routes
| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | List pages, filter by `?tag=` |
| `GET /search?q=` | FTS5 full-text search |
| `GET,POST /pages/new` | Create page |
| `GET /pages/<slug>` | View page (rendered Markdown) |
| `GET,POST /pages/<slug>/edit` | Edit page |
| `POST /pages/<slug>/delete` | Delete page |
| `GET /pages/<slug>/history` | Revision list |
| `GET /pages/<slug>/history/<id>` | View old revision |

## Key Design Choices
- **Single app.py** — no blueprints, matches existing workspace pattern
